input.prompt: Flat vector illustration for a website hero, in a clean modern corporate flat-design style with soft rounded shapes, subtle grain texture on the large background blob, and simple geometric characters. Scene: on the left, a smiling employee in a mustard-yellow sweater at a light blue desk submits a request form on a laptop. From the laptop, a dotted periwinkle-blue path winds to the right through a sequence of floating rounded step cards: a card with an approver avatar and a green check mark, a card with a small bell and clock for a reminder, a card with an upward arrow for escalation, and finally a large dashboard screen on the right with a simple progress bar chart and a green completed tick, where a second colleague in a periwinkle-blue shirt reviews it. Small paper form icons travel along the path. A yellow lightbulb with sparkles and two pale yellow gears float in the background sky. Background: one large soft light-blue organic blob shape on a pure white background with a few flat pale clouds and thin outlined globe icons. Palette: periwinkle blue #4A72D8, pale blue #C9DDF6, very light blue #E7F0FB, mustard yellow #F5B84A, soft green #3BB273, dark navy line accents #1F2A44, white. Airy, balanced composition, wide 16:9 framing, clean white space around the blob. Strictly no text, no words, no letters, no labels anywhere; every screen and card shows only abstract lines, bars and blocks.
input.negative_prompt: text, words, letters, numbers, labels, captions, typography, logos, watermark, signature, photorealistic, 3D render, dark background, heavy gradients, neon, orange magenta purple brand colors, robot chatbot mascot, clutter, extra limbs, distorted faces, blurry
